title: 第27章 符师终入阶！
novel_title: 从暮年娶妻到长生不死
content_zh:
宋家一事羡慕不来，沈云继续按自己的节奏，一天篆刻一枚符石。

    稳定的前进。

    并且，他对于体内自行运转呼吸法越发有心得，表面上看起来更清闲了。

    下午经常在院子里喝茶晒太阳，雕刻东西，修剪花草。

    有时候在巷子中和刘老下棋。

    实际上呼吸法一直在体内运转，炼化血元丹的效率更高了，一天能炼化大半枚血元丹。

    养体二重突破养体三重，沈云约莫四十枚血元丹，两个月也就差不多了。

    “沈老弟你要注意身体啊！”

    这天，下午和刘老下完棋，刘老意味深长的劝诫道。

    “？？？”

    沈云满头问号。

    “你不是年轻人了，要懂得节制！”

    刘老直言不讳：“看你这些天，行动迟缓，反应总慢半拍，和凡俗老头差不多了，身体怕是快被耗空了。”

    “我知道一个方子，老弟你要不要？”

    沈云哭笑不得，这些天他敛息诀成功大成，并且下棋时也尝试分心运转呼吸法，导致看起来反应迟钝。

    没想到在刘老眼里是他不节制，导致快速衰老。

    明明他都戒色两天了。

    不过这样更好，表面上是一个普通老者，暗地里悄悄努力。

    转眼便是三天后，随着一枚符石篆刻完毕，古卷悄然变化。

    【人道符师（一阶1/100000）】

    符师，入阶！

    只不过对于沈云而言，惊喜不大。

    有福报点相助，他制作符石成功率已经到了百分之百。

    不过再次投入福报点尝试篆刻符石，有了极大的惊喜。

    二十点福报，就能让他成功制作完最后一枚符石。

    消耗直接降低一倍。

    意味着一天可以制作两枚符石，稳赚一百二十金。

    沈云有点膨胀。

    至于一阶符石后的十万进度，在他的预料之中。

    一阶符师对应的不是养体一阶，而是对应整个养体期。

    二阶符师对应的更是血海。

    三阶那就是之前沈云听课时候那位铭千古大师的阶段了。

    “再学九种符文，就可以参加天工殿的考核，成为入阶符师。”

    沈云眼中闪过精光。
content_en:
The Song family couldn't envy him, so Shen Yun continued to carve one rune stone a day at his own pace.

    Steady progress.

    Moreover, he has become more familiar with the breathing method that works within the body, and he seems to be more relaxed on the surface.

    In the afternoon, I often drink tea and bask in the sun, carve things, and trim flowers and plants in the yard.

    Sometimes I play chess with Mr. Liu in the alley.

    In fact, the breathing method is always running in the body, and the efficiency of refining the Blood Yuan Dan is higher. It can refine more than half of the Blood Yuan Dan in one day.

    After reaching the second level of body nourishment and breaking through to the third level of body nourishment, Shen Yun had about forty blood essence pills, which was about two months.

    "Brother Shen, you have to take care of yourself!"

    On this day, after playing chess with Mr. Liu in the afternoon, Mr. Liu gave meaningful advice.

    "???"

    Shen Yun's head was full of questions.

    "You are not a young man anymore, you need to know how to control yourself!"

    Mr. Liu said bluntly: "Looking at your slow movements and slow reactions these days, you are almost like an ordinary old man. I am afraid your body is almost exhausted."

    "I know a recipe, brother, do you want it?"

    Shen Yun didn't know whether to laugh or cry. These days, he had successfully mastered the Breath Condensation Technique, and he also tried to use the breathing method while playing chess, which made him seem slow to react.

    Unexpectedly, in Mr. Liu's eyes, it was his lack of restraint that led to rapid aging.

    It was obvious that he had been quitting sex for two days.

    But it's better this way. On the surface, he is an ordinary old man, working hard secretly.

    In the blink of an eye, three days later, as the seal carving of a rune stone was completed, the ancient scroll quietly changed.

    [Humanity Talisman Master (Level 1/100000)]

    Talisman master, enter the level!

    But for Shen Yun, the surprise was not big.

    With the help of the Blessing Point, his success rate in making rune stones has reached 100%.

    However, I once again invested in the blessing points and tried to carve rune stones, and I got a great surprise.

    Twenty points of blessings would allow him to successfully make the last runestone.

    Consumption is directly doubled.

    This means that you can make two rune stones in one day and earn one hundred and twenty gold for sure.

    Shen Yun was a little swollen.

    As for the progress of 100,000 rune stones after the first level, it was within his expectation.

    The first-level Talisman Master does not correspond to the first level of body maintenance, but to the entire body maintenance period.

    The second level talisman master corresponds to the sea of ​​blood.

    The third level is the stage of Master Ming Qiangu when Shen Yun was attending the class.

    "Learn nine more kinds of runes, and then you can take the exam of Tiangong Hall and become an advanced rune master."

    Shen Yun's eyes flashed.
title_en: Chapter 27 Talisman Master finally enters the level!
